scope: Only the two unchanged rules moved past assistant and account-access styles by stylesheet consolidation.

findings.node: p with only class locale-catalog-note; Astro supplies its scope attribute
findings.reason: The note and its ancestors have no ka-* or knaba-access-* class. Assistant and account-dialog roots are separate children mounted after the footer.

findings.node: div with only class astro-route-announcer; aria-live=assertive and aria-atomic=true
findings.placement: The installed Astro runtime appends the div directly to document.body.
findings.reason: Neither this div nor body/html carries an overlay namespace class. Overlay descendant, universal, focus, media and backdrop selectors cannot match this node.

conclusion: No intersecting selector match exists on either moved-rule target; moving these two rules across the scoped overlay rules has no material cascade effect. The moved selectors also do not match overlay nodes.
changes_made: Evidence JSON only; no source changes.
limits: Static review of exported source and CSS. The two-rule normalized build diff was supplied by root, not recomputed here.
